decisive_finding.reproduction: A 2020 authority source and approval were accepted in 2026 after the envelope backdated authority_binding.captured_at into the historic approval window.
decisive_finding.cause: Approval freshness used envelope-supplied session time rather than a trusted root-issued same-session time source and did not require final mediator-time revalidation.

required_correction: bind one descriptor-safe root-issued session receipt to repository candidate authority session effect-source set issue time nonce issuer and single-use state
enforce bounded issue skew and reject missing duplicate substituted stale backdated or future receipts
use mediator-supplied trusted current time for approval freshness
reject clock rollback and expiry between validation and mediation
keep every live nonempty external-effect envelope fail closed until a trusted receipt and mediator exist
root_disposition: The proposal remains non-authoritative. Envelope validation alone never authorizes execution, and no live nonempty external effect is accepted without trusted root time and a separately adopted mediator.
no_claim_statement: This REWORK decision authorizes no external effect and changes no adopted contract, product behavior, claim ceiling, readiness, release, node closure, or goal-completion state.
